persona_summary: Marc (64) from Brugge retires on 1 February, after 41 years with the same employer. He loves to travel and saves for his grandchildren Lotte and Wout.
diary_opener: Hey Marc, I've already lived your next few months. On 1 February I retired, and that same day my hospital insurance stopped.

transactions.counterparty: Standing order, saving for Lotte & Wout

cards.body: My employer's plan ended when I retired. Because I asked within 105 days, I kept the same cover, with no medical exam or waiting period.

actions.title: Keep your hospital insurance after you retire

actions.title: Plan your retirement lump sum with a KBC adviser
actions.body: Sit down with an adviser in Brugge before February. Travel, grandchildren, a safe buffer: your plans first, then the numbers.

actions.title: KBC investment plan, step by step
actions.body: Invest part of your lump sum in a defensive fund, spread over 12 months, so you don't go in all at once.

cards.title: In March I wanted to give Lotte and Wout more, and then timing mattered
